description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. Jayantha Wijeratne Special Grade, Sri Lanka Administrative Service to the President's Staff as an Additional secretary to the President Staff effect from 20.01.2017. Appointed Mr.B.K.S.Ravindra Special Grade, Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as an Additional secretary of the President Staff effect from 09.02.2017.
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (Mr. Jayantha Wijeratne and Mr. B. K. S. Raveendra as Additional Secretaries to the President) with basic titles only. It does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it a pure "People Gazette" according to the classification rules.
